basic_details.job_title: Kozhikode District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Office Attendant/Peon, Computer Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Court, Kozhikode is preparing a list of eligible retired persons for contract appointment to 3 expected vacancies, 1 Computer Assistant/Typist and 2 Office Attendant/Peon, in the special fast track court for POCSO cases at Nadapuram. content_sections.heading: About Kozhikode District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Court, Kozhikode, under the Civil Judiciary department of Kozhikode district, in the name of the District Judge as appointing authority. The vacancies are in the special fast track court that handles only cases of sexual offences against children (POCSO) and works at Nadapuram. The notice is dated 25 November 2026 and carries the reference number A1- 11164/2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: District Judge, District Court, Court Complex, Kozhikode - 673032. The application may be submitted by hand or by post, and it must reach before 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026. Write the notification number and the words "Application for temporary appointment" on top of the envelope. This is mandatory. Use the application form printed with the notice (page 3). It asks for a recent passport size photo, name in Malayalam and in English capital letters, mobile number, age and date of birth, date of retirement and PPO number, post retired from, educational qualification, present address, work experience and other qualifications, followed by a declaration with place, date and signature. Applications received after the stipulated time will not be considered. The notice prints the court's email addresses [email protected] and [email protected] and the office phone 0495-2366091 (fax 0495-2761590) on its letterhead. It does not say that applications can be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice calls the vacancy numbers expected vacancies. The total is 3. Applicants must be retired from courts, either from the post they apply for or from a higher post. If retired court applicants are not available, persons retired from other departments will also be considered. Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. No minimum age and no age relaxation is printed. The official notification does not specify any educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis for 179 days continuously, or until the appointed person completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first. Appointment will be made in order of priority from the list prepared for these posts. Selected persons must enter into an agreement with the Government, incorporating the conditions under Kerala Service Rules Part 1, Appendix 1 and Government Order No. (P) 81/2019/Fin dated 09.07.2019.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete biodata prepared in the application form format given with the notice. Attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification and work experience. A recent passport size photo, affixed on the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The list for these posts will be prepared on the basis of scrutiny of the applications, the qualifications and an interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue. Appointments will then be made from the list in order of priority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kozhikode District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 expected vacancies: 1 Computer Assistant/Typist and 2 Office Attendant/Peon, in the POCSO special fast track court at Nadapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Judge before 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026. Applications received after that time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Persons retired from courts, from the post applied for or a higher post. If such applicants are not available, those retired from other departments will also be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay?
faq.answer: Computer Assistant/Typist is Rs. 23,360/- a month and Office Attendant/Peon is Rs. 20,280/- a month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form, attach attested copies of age, qualification and experience certificates, and submit by hand or post to District Judge, District Court, Court Complex, Kozhikode - 673032.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The notification number (A1- 11164/2026) and the words "Application for temporary appointment" must be written on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The list is prepared after scrutiny of applications, qualifications and an interview. Appointment is made from the list in order of priority.

faq.question: Q9. For how long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is on contract for 179 days continuously, or until the person completes 62 years, whichever comes first.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: The application form lists both posts with their numbers, but the notice does not say whether one person may apply for both.
